NeoSigma

Member of Technical Staff - Evals Research Engineer

Member of Technical Staff - Evals Research Engineer

The Role

We are looking for a Backend Engineer to own the systems that ingest, evaluate, and serve agent behavior data at production scale. You will work across telemetry ingestion, platform reliability, sandbox infrastructure, and the API surface that customers and integrations build on. Some weeks you will be deep in distributed systems and query performance. Other weeks you will ship a customer-facing feature across backend, APIs, and the data layer.
What you'll do:

Design and build evaluation frameworks for agentic systems
Research methods for agent evaluation, reward modeling, reward-hacking, post-training, and self-improving systems
Develop rubrics, verifiers, reward signals, and benchmarks to measure agent performance, reliability, and generalisation
Own research streams end-to-end and building infrastructure to ship working systems
Publish research findings through technical blogs, papers, and open-source contributions
What we look for:
Moving fast with high agency
Strong foundations in machine learning, deep learning, and computer science
Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation, agentic systems, reinforcement learning, or post-training
Strong programming skills in Python and experience building reliable ML research infrastructure
Strong research taste and the ability to identify and solve complex and meaningful problems 
Comfortable navigating open-ended research problems and quickly translating ideas into working implementations
High standards for experimental rigor, engineering quality, and clear technical communication

Our Core Values:

Customer Obsession - We start with the customer and work backwards. We aim to earn trust through consistent delivery, thoughtful listening, and by obsessing over customers.
Intellectual Honesty - We operate with high trust and low ego. Ideas matter more than titles, and we communicate openly and directly while assuming good intent, even in strong disagreement.
Bias for Action - We set high standards and move quickly to meet them. We prefer building and learning with customers over debating in the abstract, and we iterate based on real feedback.
Extreme Ownership - We take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks. Ownership means seeing problems through to completion and ensuring solutions truly work in practice.

Benefits and perks

Competitive salary plus meaningful equity package
Comprehensive medical benefits and generous PTO
Flexible work arrangements
Direct impact on company direction and technical decisions
High ownership and the opportunity to make a career-defining impact
Visa sponsorship

As a founding member, you’ll help define the technical foundation of NeoSigma. Your scope will grow with the company, from owning core systems end-to-end to shaping architecture, hiring, and engineering culture. This role has a natural path toward technical leadership or engineering management as the team scales.

About Us

NeoSigma is a product-driven research lab building the intelligence layer that helps close the feedback loop between your customers, products, and AI systems.

We are a small, intensely technical team of researchers and engineers who have trained frontier-scale models and widely used AI products and agents at Parallel Web, Essential AI,  MIT,  Apple, and Amazon.

We are backed by world-class investors and leaders from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Decagon and others.
